Six OWNED lines, one per HOLE the merged copy still prints on a newly mapped root: four to 1.0.0_SA_CTO (the key reader names the wrong bucket, row LGIC_BLANKFIX-D1-W2-S4) and two to 4.0.0_SA_CRO (a declared_in on an existing row; the word restricted).
